name: Eggknight
_source: Eggknight Monster Sheet (both halves, code 26A1061) + card sheet. Clash Setup (board diagram, terrain, starting positions) is in the Principality of Stone Codex — NOT yet provided.

footprint.rear: the 2 cells directly behind the footprint

levelsNote: Level box: To Hit, Wounds, Exhibition Wounds, Activations. Blue bonus row icons: starburst-with-arrow = Escalations at start of Clash (rulebook p.46), ribcage = AT bonus, V = Vigor Loss bonus.

traits.name: Humpty Charge
traits.text: Humpty Charge: The Eggknight turns to face the Attacker (if any), and moves forward 6 spaces in a straight line, then turns to face the most Knights. Humpty Charge causes Crash. If the Eggknight moves through or ends its movement on a knocked down Knight, that Knight ignores the Crash and draws a Judicium instead. If, during Humpty Charge, the Eggknight moves onto an Obstacle, it immediately stops, turns to face the most Knights and discards an Armor token from the lowest BP Level with Armor token.

traits.name: Humpty Fate
traits.text: If, during Humpty Charge, the Eggknight is about to move into a Board Edge, it immediately stops, turns to face the most Knights and discards an Armor token from the lowest BP Level with Armor token.

traits.name: Counter
traits.text: Each time the Eggknight is dealt a Wound (a Double Wound is treated as 2 Wounds), place a Generic token on this Trait. When you finish resolving the current action, if there are 3 or more Generic tokens on this Trait, discard all Generic tokens and perform Signature.

traits.name: Panzeronion
traits.text: Each BP Level has its own corresponding space on the Sheet. Each Armor token on that space increases AT of the corresponding BP cards by 1. Whenever the Eggknight loses Armor token as a result of Humpty Charge, draw the top Grave Mortis card and place a Column Terrain tile on the Board on a space designated by the coordinates on it. Additional Setup: Place a number of Armor tokens on this Trait denoted on the BP spaces below. Level 2+: Place 1 additional Armor token on each BP Level.

setup.note: Owner-confirmed: tokens equal to the BP number (1/2/3); at Level 2+ one additional token on each space (2/3/4).

traits.name: Hardboiled
traits.text: Disable the Humpty Fate Trait. When Eggknight moves into a Board Edge during Humpty Charge, instead of stopping, it turns to face the most Knights and continues movement in that direction.

traits.name: Egged On
traits.text: All Eggknight Zone Attacks without an After Final Attack gain "[Peril Check?] After Final Attack: Humpty Charge."
traits.unclear: 따옴표 앞 아이콘(검은 이빨 모양) 판독 필요 — REACT 창 아이콘일 수 있음

traits.name: Jacked
traits.text: Place discarded Armor tokens on this Trait, and apply the following penalties based on the number of tokens: 2+: Evasion Roll difficulty +1. 5+: Monster Attacks gain +1 [Evasion die]. 9+: Monster Attacks additionally cause -3 [Vigor] loss. You cannot discard Armor tokens from this Trait by any means.

traits.name: Just a Scratch
traits.text: Humpty Charge doesn't stop when moving onto Obstacles. The Eggknight can discard up to one Armor token during each Humpty Charge.

traits.name: Coup de Grace
traits.text: If a knocked down Knight would draw a Judicium, they die instead.

traits.name: Impenetrable Shell
traits.text: Each BP that has an Armor token on a corresponding space on the Sheet gains "Ultrainstinct: If you are on the Eggknight's front space, Knockback 1."

clashSetup._source: Principality of Stone Codex p.48–49 Eggknight Clash
steps: Monster Positioning: Place the Eggknight miniature on the space designated on the diagram. Determine facing direction: look at the bottom card from the Minor Mortis deck and turn the Monster in the direction indicated by the arrow in the lower left corner.
Additional Setup: Follow additional Clash Setup instructions introduced by Traits (if any).
clashSetup.aftermath: standard (Casualties, Recuperate, Loot: Victorious Search = Clash Scavenge 1 + Scavenge 3 / Forlorn Search = Scavenge 3)
